main_text.head: PRÆFATIO.
main_text.p: rebus Ecclesiæ ac Religionis præ-varicari videantur. Hinc san-guinis effusiones oriuntur & omnia sursum ac deorsum vertun-tur. Hæc igitur cum mecum a-nimo reputarem, existimabam satius fore, ut Reip. proceribus cura omnis isthæc relinqueretur, atque ego tacitum fabulæ spectatorem agerem. Sed ex altera parte me movit me Christiana charitas erga eos, quamvis de mepessimè meritos. Cui enim bono, cogita-bam, sinere ipsos ruere in justissimam indignationem superemi-nentium potestatum? cui bono permittere, quantum in te est,

page.notes: The heading "PRÆFATIO." is taken as a level 1 title. The "&" sign in "oriuntur & omnia" is printed as a ligature (et-like form); transcribed as &. "mepessimè" is printed with the words run together; transcribed as printed. The word "videantur" is printed with an initial V-form; transcribed as videantur. The catchword "ut" is set at the right, below the last full line.
